basic_info.description:
Newly restored historic building blends old and new. 209 Sanchez has just undergone a full renovation. Never-before used kitchen and new baths, cool old details + all new modern infrastructure. Huge bay windows look out onto Corona heights and the Castro cityscape. NYC style with the beauty of SF. This is a really special spot. Historic building renovated by an established building artisan. 

Consciencious and responsive property manager (not a big management company) 

Amazing A+ location on the corner of Market and Sanchez. Biker's dream! 

Steps to Dolores Park for summer 2021! Right in the heart of it all. 

Unit features: 

1 full bathroom 
1 large bedroom with tons of closet space - custom built-ins . 
1 smaller bedroom or office with separate entrance. 
 1 huge bathroom with shower and awesome tilework. In-bath washer and dryer. 
1 half bath in main living area. 
Huge, light-filled living space in the front. Charming and light and homey. All new heating, new windows, new electrics, new plumbing.
Seismically retrofitted building.
Outdoor space/parking available.

Owner pays for garbage.
